messages:
remy: Quick heads-up — I'm preparing a short playbook PR to clarify rate caps, quota tiers, and dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/956. Need fast review on SDK examples and the grafana link strategy.
olivia: Can you paste the snippet location?
remy: docs/usage/rate-caps.md and the snippet at the bottom (usage examples).
harper: Quick scan: Go example still calls `OldReportUsage(payload)` which is deprecated. Change to `usage.Report(ctx, payload)`. Also recommend showing both sync and async patterns briefly.
ash: For the "quota exhausted" behavior, be explicit. Show a 429 payload example, e.g.:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "quota_reason": "tier_limit",
  "retry_after": 30
}
```
remy: I'll add that. Good call to include `quota_reason`. Also thinking to add a compact client backoff for the Go snippet: a tiny exponential backoff using time.Sleep.
olivia: Ops note: please stop embedding raw internal dashboard IDs in public docs. Use a token like `{{dashboard_link:usage_overview}}` that the site resolves to a friendly public URL. ops-infra can maintain an internal mapping table.
ops-infra: confirming — we prefer tokens. File an ops ticket if you need a new mapping; we can add redirects.
harper: For migration guidance, include a tiny transform example for teams that still send `token_count`:
```
// compatibility shim
if p.TokenCount != 0 && p.TokenTotal == 0 {
  p.TokenTotal = p.TokenCount
}
```
remy: Adds clarity. I'll also include a short note about burst windows so customers know why short spikes might still be accepted despite a daily cap.
ash: One more: add a docs-test for the snippets. The docs-tests runner will execute small fenced Python/Go examples against the mock endpoint. Keep them self-contained.
olivia: And mark user-facing copy with `_()` for i18n extraction so translators pick up the changed strings.
remy: Thanks — checklist for PR updated: replace deprecated SDK calls, add 429 sample, tokenized dashboard links, compatibility shim, docs-tests, i18n markers, and release-note blurb. I'll queue CI once the fixes are in.
docs-bot: CI queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/956 — lint step will flag trailing whitespace in code blocks.
remy: Fixed whitespace, pushed.
docs-bot: staging deploy succeeded — https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/rate-caps (preview shows token links, snippets render, deprecated examples flagged).
remy: Verified the staging page. Merging after one more review. Will add a short line in the release notes: "Rate cap playbook: clarified 429 behavior, updated SDK examples, tokenized dashboard links."
olivia: LGTM.
remy: Merged. Closing thread.
